Ravi (CS): Weekly account check-in — quick latency slice for NIMBLE (p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming). Putting the short exec summary first.
Asha (CS Manager): Nice. Keep it concise — execs want quick numbers + one recommended action.
Ravi (CS): Exec summary:
- Streaming routes: p95 mostly 120–350ms depending on model; p99 500–900ms.
- Non-streaming routes: p95 increased this week on /generate (rw-13b) to ~540ms; p99 for rw-13b non-streaming hit ~1.9s during Thu 14:30–15:10 UTC.
- Error spike aligned with tail latency: non-streaming /generate rw-13b errors up to 2.3% at peak (primarily 504s/timeouts).
- Spend note: weekly spend +22% YoY vs last week; 65% of the incremental spend traced to rw-13b non-streaming calls.
Priya (SRE): Can you paste the route/model table? helps triage.
Ravi (CS): Pasted table (numbers are p95 / p99) — see dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/customers/nimble/health?view=latency&range=7d
- /chat-complete rw-13b: streaming 240ms / 920ms; non-streaming 560ms / 1900ms
- /generate rw-7b: streaming 170ms / 640ms; non-streaming 430ms / 1250ms
- /rerank rw-7b: non-streaming 320ms / 860ms
- /embed small-embed: cpu path 35ms / 95ms (stable)
Lena (CS): Customer reported a slow response during a partner demo yesterday; timeline overlaps with the rw-13b non-streaming p99 spike.
Omar (Infra): Logs show autoscale thrash during Thu 14:20–15:15. ops-bot report:
ops-bot: autoscale events nimble-dedicated: 2026-03-12T14:21 scale_up +3, 2026-03-12T14:35 scale_down -2, 2026-03-12T14:47 scale_up +1, 2026-03-12T15:05 scale_up +2
Omar (Infra): Also saw kernel fallback on rw-13b after a node restart:
```
2026-03-12T14:29:56Z WARN kernel-selector: selected=generic_conv, reason=node_reinit
```
Priya (SRE): Error breakdown: 504s from queue timeouts (non-streaming) and some 502s from grpc proxy flaps. Total error rate for last 7d: 0.9%, but /generate rw-13b non-streaming peaked at 2.3%.
Ravi (CS): Customer workload note — they do background batch generation for daily sync (non-streaming) that runs heavy between 14:00–15:00 UTC. That aligns with the spikes.
Lena (CS): Renewal risk assessment: Elevated attention — demo issue + spend increase. Risk = medium-high unless we show a clear remediation within 72h.
Priya (SRE): Proposed mitigations (short-term):
- Apply route-level policy: prefer streaming variant for /chat-complete during 13:00–16:00 UTC
- Increase min GPU for nimble-dedicated from 6 -> 9 for 48 hours
- Add queue-timeout bump for non-streaming calls from 3s -> 5s while infra stabilizes
Omar (Infra): Longer-term fixes: harden autoscale deadzone, improve kernel warmup health checks to avoid fallback, suggest converting batch job to streaming micro-batches to reduce per-request tail.
Ravi (CS): Action items:
- Omar: infra ticket for kernel warmup & autoscale deadzone (owner: Omar)
- Priya: apply routing override and bump min capacity (owner: Priya)
- Asha: draft customer-facing note and propose a short joint call with ops (owner: Asha)
- Ravi: prepare spend breakout and recommended batching playbook (owner: Ravi)
Asha (CS Manager): Draft customer message (short): "We saw elevated tail latency for some non-streaming rw-13b requests during your peak sync window. We've temporarily prioritized streaming calls for interactive routes and increased capacity for your dedicated pool while we roll out a kernel warmup and autoscaler fix. No data loss; next update in 24h." 
Ravi (CS): I'll post to the account thread and schedule follow-up. Any objections?
Priya (SRE): none.
Omar (Infra): fine.
Asha (CS Manager): closing. Will update once infra ticket is created and routing override applied.
